requirement: An ambiguous product request records the missing decision and does not invent acceptance criteria.
A defect route records reproduction, root cause, and a failing executable check before the fix.
Acceptance uses evidence for the exact candidate version; failed criteria block acceptance.
The first independent review receives pinned requirements, candidate artifacts and actual checks without author self-assessment.
An interrupted run resumes from durable attempts and decisions without silently replaying an uncertain host callback.
Release stays a human-authorized process with an unselected pipeline and no automatic certification.
Missing or stale telemetry produces an unknown health assessment rather than a healthy one.
